title: You own it. You just can’t use it.

lines.tax: A tax bill for touching your own money.
lines.strangers: Four holdings, treated like four strangers.
lines.friday: A loan that still thinks it’s Friday afternoon.
lines.sunday: A Sunday when your own portfolio won’t pick up.
lines.liquidation: Learning your liquidation price the day it arrives.

body: Borrowing so you don’t have to sell is not a niche. At Morgan Stanley’s wealth business, clients owe <n>$109.2 billion</n> in securities-based and other lending, against <n>$31.2 billion</n> in margin loans. On-chain, every Stock Token is still priced alone. <link>Where that comes from</link>.
